title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts — Refund Computation on a Traded-Vehicle Cancellation
content:
## Refund clause
On a traded-vehicle cancellation of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the refund is worked as follows.

**(a) Flat refunds.** These take precedence over the pro-rata refund:
- a contract cancelled within the coverage level's free-look days after its sale date with no claim paid (claims paid less reversals at zero) is refunded its full retail price;
- a contract sold on a purchase deal that has been unwound is refunded its full retail price.

**(b) Pro-rata refund.** The refund is the retail price times the unused share, rounded half up to the cent, less the coverage level's cancellation fee, and never below 0.00. No claims are deducted, and it is recorded under the pro-rata basis.

**(c) Unused share.** The unused share is the lesser of the unused time share and the unused mileage share. A coverage level that refunds on time alone uses the unused time share only, and a share below zero counts as zero.
- **Unused time share.** The days from the effective date to the expiration date, over the days from the term start date to the expiration date.
- **Unused mileage share.** The miles from the certified odometer to the expiration odometer, over the term miles.

**(d) Forming the shares.**
- **Days used.** The elapsed days are the calendar days from the term start date to the effective date. The days used are the elapsed days, net of any days of the term credited to the holder, never below zero.
- **Time share.** The unused time share is the term's days less the days used, over the term's days.
- **Mileage share.** The unused mileage share is the term's starting odometer plus the term miles, less the reading, over the term miles.
- **In-service terms.** For a term counted from the in-service date, the time and miles before the sale date count as used.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)
- **Inputs.** Price 1850.00. A 1096-day term with term miles of 36000, from 26000 miles. Effective date 500 days into the term. Certified odometer 47500. A hypothetical fee of 50.00.
- **Time share.** 596 over 1096, about 0.54380.
- **Mileage share.** 26000 plus 36000 less 47500 is 14500, over 36000: about 0.40278.
- **Refund.** The lesser share is 0.40278. 1850.00 times that is 745.14, less 50.00 gives 695.14.
